title: Knight Lore collectables
description: Where each of the thirty-two collectables lies when a game starts, and the order the wizard asks for them in. specials_source.py turns this into specials_gen.s, which knightlore.s INCLUDEs.

comment.description: Prose for whoever opens the file. Nothing reads it.

wantedComment.description: Prose about `wanted`, kept beside it. Nothing reads it.

game.description: Which game this belongs to. Only Knight Lore has a collectables table.

collectables.description: The thirty-two rows of special_where_start, in the game's own order. special_init copies the whole table over special_where in one LDIR at the start of every game, so it is a fixed length -- adding or removing a row changes what the game reads, and specials_source.py stops rather than emit a short table.

room.description: The room it starts in. Knight Lore's map is a 16 x 16 grid and the number is a row and a column, so $6D is row 6, column 13.

u.description: World U, towards the viewer. A room's floor is centred on 128.

v.description: World V, away from the viewer. A room's floor is centred on 128.

z.description: World Z, up. The floor of a room is at its size's floorZ, so a collectable resting on the floor sits at that height, not at 0.

wanted.description: The fourteen kinds the wizard asks for, in order. special_init turns the list round four to seven places before a game, so this is only where the turning starts. SPECIAL_WANTED in the game is 14 and the two have to agree.

items.description: A kind, 0 to 7 -- special.s matches it against a collectable's graphic AND 7.
